ideas.idea: Give each route its own title (and description) beyond the index.html defaults
ideas.why: Largely overlaps the known title/description problem, with per-route titles being a standard add-on.

ideas.idea: Prerender or server-render the catalogue list so mug names are in the HTML instead of fetched client-side
ideas.why: Catalogue.jsx fetches /api/mugs in useEffect, so mug names are absent from the initial HTML; this is specific and accurate.

ideas.idea: Create per-mug pages like /catalogue/<id> with description and price
ideas.why:
Catalogue.jsx renders each mug only as a name in a

, so there is no individual URL to find or link.

ideas.idea: Expand home page content with materials, sizes, prices, shipping details
ideas.why: Home.jsx has a single sentence describing the shop, so more factual content would help readers and machines.

ideas.idea: Add Product structured data (JSON-LD) for the mug facts
ideas.why: The repo has no JSON-LD and sells products, so Product markup fits and is concrete.

ideas.idea: Add a <meta name="viewport"> tag to index.html
ideas.why: Accurate, since index.html has none, but it's a standard item for any site.

ideas.idea: Add an absolute canonical link on each page (needs domain)
ideas.why: Accurate that none exists, but it's standard advice that depends on an unknown domain.
